projects.name: Sales Bot with Q&A and RFP Generation	Jul 2025 - Present
projects.description:
Sales Bot with Q&A and RFP Generation	Jul 2025 - Present
Developed an intelligent sales automation system using LangChain and vector databases to handle customer queries and generate RFP responses. Integrated with multiple data sources to provide contextual answers and automated proposal generation.
Implemented RAG architecture using Weaviate vector database for efficient document retrieval
Built conversational interface using LangChain with custom prompt templates for RFP generation
Created automated RFP response pipeline with 85% accuracy in requirement matching
Deployed using LangGraph for complex multi-agent workflows and response orchestration
Doctor's Support Agent (CrewAI-Agentic RAG-OpenAI-Streamlit)	Apr 2025 - Jul 2025
Developing an AI-powered healthcare agent using CrewAI, OpenAI, and Streamlit integrated with a CI/CD pipeline to automate patient symptom analysis, disease prediction, lab test recommendation, and insurance mapping.
Built a natural language processing pipeline to extract symptoms from user input.
Implemented disease mapping logic and integrated lab test suggestion engine.
Designed an insurance mapping module based on patient insurance ID and provider rules.
Automated deployment and version control with CI/CD for reliable updates and scalability.
Loan Default Prediction Using EDA	Jul 2023 - Aug 2023
Conducted comprehensive Exploratory Data Analysis using Python (Pandas, NumPy) to uncover patterns and correlations between consumer behaviors, loan characteristics, and default risks. Applied statistical analysis and feature engineering techniques to identify crucial risk factors.
Performed data preprocessing and cleaning on 50K+ loan records using Pandas and scikit- learn
Implemented correlation analysis, distribution plots, and statistical hypothesis testing using Seaborn and Matplotlib for data visualization
Generated actionable insights through feature importance analysis, reducing potential loan defaults	through data-driven risk mitigation strategies
